title: Deletion Evidence Record (DER)
description: Captures a deletion/data-exit action and its execution state. This record documents an asserted/executed deletion action. It is NOT independent proof that every physical copy of the underlying data was destroyed. See /spec/deletion-evidence-record.md for the normative specification.

record_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this record. RFC 4122 UUID recommended.

record_type.description: Fixed discriminator identifying this as a Deletion Evidence Record.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp marking when this record object was created.

request_id.description: Identifier of the originating deletion/data-exit request. Reference only — not a personal identifier.

requested_at.description: When the deletion/data-exit request was made.

requesting_role.description: Functional role that initiated the request (e.g. 'data_subject', 'customer_admin', 'procurement', 'hr'). Not a personal name.

requesting_organization_ref.description: Opaque reference to the requesting organization, where applicable. Must not contain personal data.

data_category.description: General category of data in scope (e.g. 'customer_account_data', 'employee_hr_record', 'crm_contact_record'). Not a value taxonomy — free text by design.

subject_ref.description: Opaque/pseudonymous reference to the subject, account, or resource. MUST NOT be a real personal identifier (name, email, national ID).

scope_description.description: Human-readable description of what the deletion/data-exit action covers.

systems_in_scope.description: Opaque identifiers or names of systems in scope for this action.

processors_in_scope.description: Opaque identifiers or names of third-party processors/subprocessors in scope, if any.

executed_at.description: When execution completed or was last attempted. Null if not yet executed.

execution_method_declaration.description: Declarative, non-technical statement of how execution was asserted to occur (e.g. 'account and associated records marked for deletion via standard offboarding workflow'). This field records an assertion, not verifiable technical proof.

backup_state.description: Declarative statement of backup status relevant to this action (e.g. 'included in standard 30-day backup rotation').

residual_copies_declared.description: Whether any residual copies are declared to exist at the time of this record.

retention_exception.description: Description of any retention exception applying to this data (e.g. statutory retention period).

legal_hold.description: Whether a legal hold applies to any part of the scoped data.

subprocessor_status.description: Declarative status of subprocessor completion, if processors_in_scope is non-empty.

source_system_id.description: Opaque identifier of the system that generated this record.

responsible_party_reference.description: Opaque reference to the party responsible for executing/recording this action. Not a personal name.

evidence_references.description: Opaque references (e.g. ticket IDs, log IDs) supporting this record. Must not embed personal data or secrets.

canonicalization_method.description: Identifies the canonicalization algorithm used to compute record_hash. See /spec/hashing.md.

record_hash.description: SHA-256 hash (lowercase hex) of the canonicalized record with this field itself excluded. Verifies integrity of the evidence record only — it does NOT independently prove physical deletion occurred in external systems.
